p.src: 1  I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

ja: いが底知れぬ所の鍵と大きな鎖を手に持ち、
en: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
u.src: 1  I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

p.src: 2  He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

ja: 御使いは、竜、すなわち、全世界を惑わす者で、
またサタンである、あの
en: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,
u.src: 2  He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

ja: 20:2 TRとNUは「全世界を惑わす者」を省いている。
en: 20:2 TR and NU omit “who deceives the whole inhabited earth”.

p.src: 3  and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

ja: わるまで、竜がこれ以上
わさないようにするためである。その
たれなければならない。
en: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.
u.src: 3  and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

p.src: 4  I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

ja: えられた。また、イエスのあかしと
en: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
u.src: 4  I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

p.src: 5  The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

ja: らなかった。これが第一の復活である。
en: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
u.src: 5  The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

p.src: 6  Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

ja: となり、キリストとともに
en: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.
u.src: 6  Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

p.src: 7  And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison

en: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison
u.src: 7  And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison

p.src: 8  and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.

en: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.
u.src: 8  and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.

p.src: 9  They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

ja: んだ。しかし、神のもとから
en: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.
u.src: 9  They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

p.src: 10  The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

en: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
u.src: 10  The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

p.src: 11  I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.

en: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.
u.src: 11  I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.

p.src: 12  I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

ja: かれた。それは命の書である。
に書かれていることに基づき、自分たちの
en: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.
u.src: 12  I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

p.src: 13  The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

en: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.
u.src: 13  The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

p.src: 14  Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

en: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
u.src: 14  Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

p.src: 15  If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

en: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.
u.src: 15  If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.
